lesson_block:
### Do not use a destination ledger to delete owner-final material
A rolling unincorporated-ideas ledger preserves genuinely extra material; it cannot turn a still-relevant owner-final point into `banked/unplaced` material because the point disrupts a preferred architecture, word count, sourcing workflow, or detector strategy. Preserve the current destination. If a concrete better destination exists, show it and ask Joel before moving. A review Joel says is settled stays settled at his stated certainty unless materially new contradictory evidence appears, the authoritative claim becomes unclear, or Joel asks to reopen it. A missing inline source link remains a publication-readiness issue, not authority to delete, weaken, or re-review protected working prose. This is a fidelity and workflow rule, not support for any particular factual claim.
